notes.title: AI Improvement and Quality of Life Patches
notes.content:
Hello Electioneers!

It's been a while since our last patch.  We've been working on overhauling the experience to be more fun!  Meanwhile, until that larger work is ready, we have some AI improvements and a Quality of Life patch.

[h3]Candidate AI Work[/h3]
[list]
[*] Candidates now take out ad sizes other than just large.
[*] Candidates were researching Topics more than once sometimes, wasting money
[*] 
[/list]

[h3]Bug Patches[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fog of War is toggleable. Now you can click on an item, and it will toggle to the next state.
[*] Newsletter rises from the bottom and drops down.  It was fading in, which made no sense since it's labeled expand!
[*] When you cancel an ad/poll, that confirmation modal no longer shows up on other monitors if you switched to them. 
[*] If you cancel an ad/poll, the assignments tab count now properly updates
[*] When setting up a recurring poll, the question mark now shows up without a linebreak
[*] You can now properly see all ad buy sizes in the hacker dossier
[/list]

We're looking forward to getting you some much larger changes over the next ~6 weeks!

Best

Jordan

notes.title: Mid-week update
notes.content:
Hi there Electioneers!

We just pushed out an update, and so here is the changelog!

When you visit the Media agent, if there are Issues presented to you that aren't researched, you are now cued into that with a visual treatment.  Also, you'll get linked to the researcher if you try to click on the one you don't have any topics for.

We fixed an end-of-turn bug showing which candidate is pulling ahead.  The calculation wasn't quite right before, and so there were some incorrect forecasts!

We made a small balancing change around turn income.  We're forecasting how many actions/turns we'd like you to be able to afford, and the income was just not in line with that forecast.  We're working on a more dynamic income system, but for now, an income boost should help.
	
When the game starts, if you click on Your News, you now get an intro for each agent.
	
There was a big with the start of Turn Profit & loss calculation. We patched this up.

We're working on a large balancing pass on the voters and events.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38851945/dd1d49074382c449793cd5c9463c65e421acef1f.png[/img]

That's a preview of our Miro board, so they're a lot of moving parts there!  We'll be working through this over the next 2 weeks, and hopefully, we'll be posting a large update to make the gameplay.

Best,

Jordan

notes.title: Holiday Update ready, introducing the Infiltrator
notes.content:
Hello Electioneers,

We just pushed out an update that has a couple of big changes.

1.  We introduced the new Infiltrator Agent.  The infiltrator will get into a state and get the people all riled up about the issue!  He can only travel to one place at a time, so his actions are limited to 1 per turn.  When he gets in there, he basically causes a large increase in the issue's importance without necessarily changing opinions.  This will let you take an issue your candidate is leading in but which isn't very important and greatly increase awareness.  This will lead to more fundraising and more votes for your candidate!  Although you have to be careful, events and ads can help swing this now critical issue the other way, so you have to stay on top of it!

2.  We updated the beginning turn "Newsletter" Your Feed part and made some changes to the content generation.  Now, based on what you're doing in the game, Your Feed should reflect some basic narrative elements to make it more interesting

A few things are coming up in the next 2 weeks or less.

1.  Phishing Sites.  We're working on these. They'll solve the issue of static income. You'll be able to create phishing sites, which enable you to redirect fundraising from candidates into your pocket!
2.  We have some large changes coming to candidate AI. This will include looking at more things they can do, like giving speeches, traveling, things like that.  We want the basic 2020 events to remain true while greatly increasing replayability by having a much more dynamic range of optional candidate actions.
3.  We're going to be continuing to work on the narrative elements.  Right now, every action you do result in a discreet tile on Your Feed.  We'll be working on making it less one action for one tile and more of a narrative format weaved based on your actions taken as more than individual actions.

Past that, we're looking into a few things.

Internationalization/localization, a simplified structure for taking out ads, Steam Achievements, a few bug fixes, and more agent actions!  We'll also be doing a large pass on the game balancing once the Phishing Sites are out.  We're going to have to spend some time making sure the funds in and funds out along with the costs of all your actions give you plenty to do and keep things interesting.

Thanks for all of your support!

Jordan

notes.title: Newest Patch available
notes.content:
Hello Electioneers,

We have a few updates we just pushed live that we mentioned a few days ago.

1. A new DataBank feature that will let you learn more about how to play the game, and it also provides supplementary information on the different real-world events going on during the game time.  We'll continue to build out the content for this and add some guides to it.

2. New turns will begin with a "Newsletter" rather than the pop out from the phone in the bottom right. We want to give you more space to explore the things happening each turn. We've moved all the events over to the Newsletter.  We also added a "Your News" section, which is focused on procedurally generating news to correspond with how your in-game actions are affecting things.  Right now, this is pretty basic, but we'll be pushing updates to it in the next week, or so that'll hopefully feel more immersive.  Also, we've built out a "News Ticker" that lives at the bottom of the screen so you can see the events scrolling by.

3. A nicer ending to the game. We have some end game animations we're putting together, and also you'll be able to explore the map once the game is finished if you want to mine around for more information :) As a strategy and specifically political game junkie myself, when the game is over, I want to absorb all that information and really dig into what happened, so we'll try to give you players that experience.

4.  Some small bug fixes.
  A small patch for our mac players.  Some of you may have had a disproportionately large mouse cursor!  
    If you were affected by this, hopefully, it'll be normal-sized now.
  If you restart the game from within a current game, the proper menu music now plays.


We'll continue to work on the next update.  Candidates for that update are.
1.  Getting the infiltrator into the game.  We already have his dialogue and actions. We're just trying to work on some balancing.
2.  Phishing sites so you can target the candidate's income!
3.  Better procedural content for "Your News"

Our goal is to get that content out before the end of the year.

Best,

Jordan

notes.title: New Candidate Dossier Screen
notes.content:
Hello Electioneers!

We just pushed up a new update that introduces the Hacker Dossier.  

Now when you hack Candidates, you'll get a dossier on their priorities, how much money they have, how many ads they're running in a state, if they are polling, and what their fundraising looks like.  We managed to squeeze in a historical feature as well that wasn't originally planned.  Now, you can also see what the Candidates were up to every turn leading up to the hack when you hack a candidate!  It makes sense, the candidates are keeping detailed files, and you're breaking in, so we wanted to give you the information that we felt might reasonably be accessible to a hacker.  There is some oddity when using the new Hacker feature with a saved game, this is due to the fact that the historical information wasn't being collected.  However, we did include a patch so the game ought not to crash, however, this historical information can't be displayed for previous versions of the game.

This update also is our first introduction to multiple monitors!  In the future, we'll be leaning on the monitors more to give you a more detailed and immersive set of insights into what is going on in the game.

We're going to push up another update shortly. We're working on some enhancements to the End Game, making it a bit more entertaining/engaging/suspenseful!

Following that, we're working on 
1. How we present the Events at the start of the turn.  It feels like maybe we've outgrown having a popout on the bottom left.  We'd like to find a way to communicate better the gravity of the events that are going on during the game!
2.  The Infiltrator, we have a powerful new feature in mind to introduce the Infiltrator.
3.  A new feature for the Hacker to set up and maintain phishing sites, this will encourage you to steal fundraising from the candidates, depriving them of cash while also funding your activities!
4.  An interactive "encyclopedia," which will help you explore game concepts as needed.

I hope you enjoy it!

Jordan

notes.title: New Fundraising system!
notes.content:
Hello Electioneers!

We just rolled an update out, which we hope adds some interesting strategic depth!

When you look at a State detail screen, you now get information on how the candidate is fundraising in the state.  You can hover over the Issues, and you will see an estimate of how much money the Candidate is raising from that state each turn!  The fundraising a candidate does in a state is a function of two things. Firstly how widespread an issue is in the state and secondly how important the voters in that state consider that issue.  

The importance is different from approval, you can think an issue is important, and it does not speak to who you favour.  Use these new insights to decide which Issues you support or sabotage to help your candidate out!  This update is mostly to introduce the new fundraising system. Before this, the candidate fundraising was more linear and simple.  The graphs are just the first way we're surfacing that information, so we wanted to get that out to you!  

We also made changes to the save game system.  There was a condition resulting in generation of "orphaned" save files if you were overwriting an existing save.  We made some changes to the system to avoid that and to clean up any orphaned files.  There seem to be some issues with loading certain saves when combined with the new Fundraising system.  If you are affected by this and want to see us work on a patch, please let us know in the comments.  In lieu of that, we'll be working on new features coming to you next week!  

What we're working on and is coming up in the next updates.

1.  Adding more music into the game
2.  A new screen to manage hacker information.  This will help you see nationally how a candidate is raising and spending money.  What their goals are!.  
3.  A new basic finances screen to make it easier to track your expenses across the nation and make it easier to mass cancel your activities.
4.  We've got the Infiltrator coming up!  We're working on our fourth agent.  He'll bring a unique ability with him to start, going into a state and getting the people riled up on an issue!  He can only take 1 action per turn, but his first ability is potent!  Imagine your candidate is leading on an issue, but the issue isn't super important.  Yet!  Suddenly your infiltrator goes in and stirs people up. Suddenly this issue shoots up in importance.  Now your candidate is favoured, the issue is important, and it should have a solid fundraising impact on them and really hurt your opponent.  You can use this strategy to help or hurt whoever you want.  Starve their funds off or help them on the road to victory!


Best

Jordan

notes.title: Hacker is now in play!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We just pushed a new update which adds our 3rd agent, the Hacker!

[b]Hacker[/b]
The Hacker is our newest addition to the Agent roster!  He's meant to be a very powerful utility agent and a way to engage with the candidates directly.  Due to the power of the Hacker, he comes with a limitation of one action per turn. Right now, he only has 1 thing he can do, steal information from the Candidates, but there'll be more actions coming shortly!  Hopefully, with this new ability, you can have a bit more information informing which states you want to focus on.  As we flesh out more around Candidate Fundraising and present that (coming soon!), the Hacker will become even more powerful.

A quick note, the hacker, will not show up in your saved games.  Only new ones, we can look into patching this, but we felt it was more important to get this Agent into the game.

[b]Core Improvement[/b]
1.  Improved Candidate AI.  We made some substantial changes to how the Candidates rank their state priorities.  This was important since you can actually steal those priorities now with the hacker!  Right now you just see their state focus, but we'll be working on adding information on what Ads they're running.

2.  State Results screen.  We made some changes to the End Turn screen, specifically the portion where you see the State Results.  We're hoping this will have a tighter and more integrating than the previous two-panel screen.  This screen is still a bit difficult because it really shows two things.  First, it shows you change between turns on a state you have information on. In this case, you can expect smaller changes, +1, +2, in a direction.  However, there's also the case of your first poll in a state, in which case you see the entirety of the lean so that it may look stunning, like a +17.  Since this was confusing, for this second case we're now just showing the leaning of the state.  So if you see a lonely caret and wonder, hopefully, this helps!  We'll keep working on ways to make this screen more intuitive

[b]UI Improvement[/b]
We increased the size of the Cancel button on the state details panel.  It was too small and hard to target. Hopefully, it's easier now.


We have many more changes coming up.  Here's a peek at our short term roadmap.  We're hoping to have these up in a series of updates by 11/11.  

[list]
[*] New Music.  We have some more tracks we're going to be getting in the next 1 or 2 updates.
[*] End Game Screen.  We've got a more comprehensive End Game screen that hopefully will feel more rewarding and help build more anticipation!
[*] Candidate Fundraising.  We're going to be tying Candidate Fundraising in with how a candidate performs on the Issues in a state.  States have relative wealth now, but the fundraising feels static.  Once a substantial lead or loss on the Issues impacts the candidate, it'll require more strategy from you to make sure your candidate is competitive in their fundraising!  We'll be using the Hacker to help you understand how much money Candidates are raising in a state.
[*] Dynamic Income.  Right now, income is feeling very static.  Well, it is very static, so it's high on our list to address that.  We're going to be leveraging the Hacker again to help you achieve a more dynamic income, at the candidates' expense!  
[*] UI Cleanup.  We've got some general cleanup of the UI to do, we'll be prioritizing that in the next rounds of updates.
[/list]

After that, we have some more coming up a week or so after.
[list]
[*] New more intuitive/informative button styles coming up that'll help us give you more information on what you're doing without just making giant green blocks.
[*] We'll be introducing more variation in the Media agent ads.  We'd like you to be able to run Small/Medium/Large ad buys.  We could do this now, but pairing it with the new button styles will help us give you the information to make more informed choices.
[/list]

This is by no means meant to be comprehensive, we've got lots and lots of plans for more actions with the Agents and more engagements with the candidates, as well as mechanical updates.

notes.title: Update with in-game tips, better ai, and a bug fix

notes.title: Major balancing changes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We introduced some substantial in-game balancing changes today.

[list]
[*] So top line most visible, we modified the Ad and Poll pricing again.  We wanted you to feel like you can afford to run more polls and lift the Fog of War more (See the toggle in the top left of the in-game UI!).  
[*] Much larger, though, are under the hood effects.  We made large changes to how the Ads and Events function.  You should be able to target some states now and really be able to make an impact.  Tuning is an ongoing thing, especially as we add new features in, and they cause some swings in terms of what you're able to do.
[*] If you get the End Turn insufficient funds message, you'll now be told how much you have to cancel.
[*] We lowered the time until the Agent Dialogue auto-closes.
[/list]

[b]We have some further upcoming changes in the next week or so.[/b]

[list]
[*] We've got additional musical tracks we plan to get in
[*] We'll be improving the Dialogue System
[*] We'll be adding in some tips to help you navigate your way through the user interface
[*] We're working on a nicer End-Game experience.
[*] We're working on getting the Hacker in shape so we can add that 3rd agent in!
[*] Canceling ads currently is inconsistent in terms of the messaging.  We aim to make it more informative in terms of the canceling value.
[/list]

Also, although we've been able to avoid any breaking changes, we'll likely push a patch next week that will invalidate Saved Games.  Ironically the reason is we're specifically making changes to our Content to avoid breaking changes in the future.  Unfortunately, there's a cost here this time around.  Since we're in Early Access, I think there's always some risk of breaking changes, but we'll always do our absolute best to minimize this and always make sure it's accompanied by changes that are of great value to compensate!

Best

Jordan

notes.title: Some quality of life changes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We just rolled out another patch.

[list]
[*] 	Researcher now shows you the price for the topic and asks you to confirm.  It wasn't obvious before she was charging you!
[*] 	Agent Dialogue auto-closes after 1.5 seconds when you are done talking.  No more having to click the X

[*] 	Small Balance Adjustment to how quickly issues spread results in a slower seeding of issues across states, and also a bit less uniform.  We'll be preparing additional work on this, right now it's still feeling a bit tough to push a state your way, this should help a bit, but we're putting effort into a more comprehensive set of mechanic changes.
[/list]

Best

Jordan

notes.title: Volume Control and Balancing Patch
notes.content:
Hello!

We put out another patch today, and it covers 3 things.

[list]
[*] [b]We have a volume control in-game now[/b].  You can access it from Settings on the Main Menu or from the in-game menu (accessed by hitting escape)
[*] [b]We slowed down how quickly voters will declare allegiance[/b].  Although it's not surfaced yet, voters have an underlying Enthusiasm, and this helps determine if a Voter is undecided or not.  The speed at which their enthusiasm was changing was a bit faster than we would like, resulting in some larger swings in the states between turns. We made some balancing changes around how Voters respond to the Events going on in the game, as well as ads from you and the Candidates.
[*][b]We tweaked the formula for Ad/Poll costs[/b].  It felt like they were a little high for the turn income.  State Ads and Poll costs are controlled by their population.  Due to that, it can get costly to run an ad in a big state.  We could increase your income, but then it would be too easy to spam the smaller states with tons of ads and constant polling.  So instead, what we did was we lowered the difference between the Cheapest states and most Expensive states from a 7.0 multiplier to 6.5 and made the cheapest states a bit cheaper. 
[/list]

Thanks for tuning in!

notes.title: Small balancing update
notes.content:
Hello, we just wanted to announce pushing a small balance fix.

The balance fix involves 3 things.

1.  Increasing the starting funds.
2.  Increasing the funds each turn
3.  A small adjustment to how Ads function.  Your ads should be more effective now.  

Reasons for the change.  So originally we had hoped to ship the Hacker in the first EA build.  Due to time constraints we weren't able to do that.  As a result, it threw the balancing off a bit.  I won't spoil it but the Hacker has some new ways for you to make money.  The Hacker also gives you more insights into what the candidates are up to.  So in order to compensate a bit until the Hacker is ready (Hopefully soon!) we've made these balance tweaks which when running through multiple games gives a much better sense of empowerment to the Electioneer.

Hope you enjoy, we'll have some more updates soon regarding the way the Agent interactions function.  Making things a bit easier and more consistent/informative.

Thank you!

notes.title: We Launched! We have a Small post Patch ready
notes.content:
We got the game launched last night. Thanks so much to everyone who has followed the game or checked it out!

We just pushed up a small patch with things.

[olist]
[*]  The in-game menu (accessible by hitting escape or the menu icon in the top right) now has an option to "Start a new game," so you don't have to quit to desktop and relaunch!  
[*]  There was an issue with Loading that we ran into just after launch that we resolved.  Saving and loading should work fine now. We tested it across multiple platforms.
[/olist]
Thanks again for joining us on this new game adventure!  We will be releasing patches and updates as frequently as we can.  We already have a lot more built-out in the code and data than the UI is surfacing, so we expect to move very quickly.

On our short term, the priority list is
